ck_invitation_record_recipient_target.name: ck_invitation_record_recipient_target
ck_invitation_record_recipient_target.value:
(
        ("invitation_record"."recipient_type" = 'member' and "invitation_record"."member_id" is not null and "invitation_record"."organization_id" is null)
        or
        ("invitation_record"."recipient_type" = 'organization' and "invitation_record"."member_id" is null and "invitation_record"."organization_id" is not null)
      )

uk_member_id_document.name: uk_member_id_document
uk_member_id_document.where: "member"."id_type" is not null and "member"."id_number" is not null

chk_resource_transport_only.name: chk_resource_transport_only
chk_resource_transport_only.value: "activity_resource"."resource_type" = 'transport' OR ("activity_resource"."transport_scene" IS NULL AND "activity_resource"."vehicle_info" IS NULL AND "activity_resource"."driver_name" IS NULL AND "activity_resource"."driver_phone" IS NULL)

chk_resource_time_range.name: chk_resource_time_range
chk_resource_time_range.value: "activity_resource"."start_time" IS NULL OR "activity_resource"."end_time" IS NULL OR "activity_resource"."start_time" <= "activity_resource"."end_time"

uk_seat_assignment_member.name: uk_seat_assignment_member
uk_seat_assignment_member.where: "seat_assignment"."revoked_at" is null and "seat_assignment"."segment_member_id" is not null

chk_seat_assignment_occupant.name: chk_seat_assignment_occupant
chk_seat_assignment_occupant.value:
(
        ("seat_assignment"."occupant_type" = 'person'
          and "seat_assignment"."segment_member_id" is not null
          and "seat_assignment"."organization_id" is null)
        or
        ("seat_assignment"."occupant_type" = 'organization'
          and "seat_assignment"."segment_member_id" is null
          and "seat_assignment"."organization_id" is not null)
      )
